verdict.rationale: Cekura has no documented prompt playground. Developers can still iterate on prompts and models indirectly: they can A/B test two agent versions to measure prompt or model changes, run the same scenarios across models, and create and test agents on Cekura without external keys. Missing for 10: an interactive prompt playground, prompt variable/template support, direct model selection in an editor, and independent corroboration of the prompt-iteration workflow.
